name: Halo Salon & Spa
tagline: Hair, skin, nails and body under one roof on Linden Avenue — unhurried appointments, honest prices, and people who remember how you like it.

ticker.text: Gift cards at the front desk

menu_groups.name: Hair
menu_groups.body: Cuts, blowouts and styling for every length and texture.
menu_groups.imageAlt: A stylist cutting a client's shoulder-length dark hair by a bright window

menu_groups.name: Colour
menu_groups.body: Balayage, gloss and grey blending, planned at a free consult.
menu_groups.imageAlt: A colourist brushing honey balayage onto sections of long brown hair

menu_groups.name: Skin
menu_groups.body: Facials matched to your skin on the day, not a script.
menu_groups.imageAlt: An esthetician applying a cream mask to a relaxed client's cheek

menu_groups.name: Nails
menu_groups.body: Long-wear manicures and pedicures with properly clean tools.
menu_groups.imageAlt: A nail technician painting a client's nails a deep merlot red

menu_groups.name: Body
menu_groups.body: Massage in a quiet room, with as much or as little talk as you like.
menu_groups.imageAlt: A quiet treatment room made up with white linen, warm stones and eucalyptus

menu_note: Prices are where an appointment starts. Longer or thicker hair may take more time, and we always tell you before we begin.

approach_stats.label: Every appointment starts with a conversation, not a cape.
Stylists, colourists and therapists — each a specialist.
On Linden Avenue, with many of the same clients.

booking_policy.text: Book online, by phone, or at the front desk.
Free cancellation up to 24 hours before.
New colour clients get a free patch test and consult.

art_direction.identity: A neighbourhood salon and spa with a magazine eye: rose-porcelain canvas, blush-clay panels, aubergine ink, one merlot accent, bright daylight photography cut into arches like salon mirrors.
art_direction.type: Bodoni Moda (regular, with an italic phrase in most headlines) for every heading and price; Manrope for body and UI. Headlines large and airy, body at a comfortable reading size.
art_direction.color: One accent: merlot (bg-primary / text-primary) for buttons, prices, and the italic word in a headline. Aubergine (bg-secondary) carries exactly one dark band — the visit section. Everything else is canvas, blush surface, cream cards, ink and muted text. Never add another color.
art_direction.signature: The treatment menu — services printed like a spa menu with dotted leaders, durations and merlot prices, beside a tall arched photo that changes to match the group being read. Keep the arch shape on photographs wherever the design evolves.
art_direction.voice: Warm, assured, a little wry. Short sentences and real details — times, prices, names. No exclamation marks, no 'pamper yourself', no 'luxurious experience'.
